title_en: An Octopus Has Three Hearts, and One Stops When It Swims #Shorts
title_ko: 문어의 심장은 셋, 헤엄칠 땐 하나가 멈춘다
desc_en:
Two hearts push blood through the gills; one pumps it to the body. The blood is blue because copper-based hemocyanin, not iron, carries oxygen. When an octopus swims, the body heart stops beating, which is one reason it would rather crawl.

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine, "Ten Wild Facts About Octopuses"; Shedd Aquarium; Live Science.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
